evals.prompt: We don't have source access to this vendor's chatbot widget on our site - can you poke at it and tell me how it actually behaves?
evals.expected_output: Confirms authorization/scope via shared-llm-probe-runner before sending anything, sends a spread of normal/ambiguous/out-of-scope/partial-capability requests, tags each behaviorally without over-judging severity, and writes explore-llm-behavior.json.

evals.prompt: After our last prompt change, can you get a behavioral baseline so we can compare before/after?
evals.expected_output: Runs the same representative spread of request types, records exact prompts/responses with neutral tags, and notes it as a baseline suitable for a before/after diff rather than a security verdict.
